g.title: Blackbody (Planckian) locus, CIE 1931 2-degree observer
g.desc: Planck spectra integrated against CIE 1931 2-degree colour matching functions at 1 nm from 360 to 830 nm; 1000 to 25000 K. Coordinate mapping follows the existing plot axes.
